title: Incident classifier and SLO-boundary visualization for cross-service error attribution
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Build an automated incident-classification pipeline and a companion SLO-boundary visualization to make cross-service error attribution and latency degradation patterns immediately actionable for oncall and platform owners. This ticket scopes: 1) a rule+ML based 'incident classifier' that tags traces/spans into a standardized taxonomy (timeout, overload/backpressure, model-inference-error, model-timeout, rpc-transport (HTTP/gRPC) codes, client-misuse, infra-fault); 2) new dashboard widgets that show SLO boundary breaches aligned with classifier clusters and sample traces; 3) sampling and enrichment changes (tracehook + span-level enrichment) and a lightweight scoring library to run in the trace forwarders. Goals: reduce mean time to owner by 40%, surface systematic model regressions tied to specific model versions, and make overload vs model error split explicit in dashboards for easier rollback/fallback decisions.
acceptance_criteria: Classifier produces tags for >=95% of traced incidents in synthetic replay (timeout, overload, model-error, transport-error, client), validated against labeled set of 2k traces
Dashboard contains a daily SLO breach heatmap with drilldowns to representative traces and the top 5 contributing services
Tracehook library added to runtime SDKs (Go/Python/Node) with opt-in flag and minimal p95 latency overhead (<1ms median per request path)
Sampling policy that biases towards SLO breaches, model-variant changes, and 10% of normal traffic is implemented in the forwarder and validated on staging
Runbook additions and pager routing updated to include classifier tags and recommended owners

dashboard_widgets: SLO-boundary heatmap: service x time cells colored by breach intensity and predominant classifier tag
Top contributors panel: ranked services and model-variants contributing to breaches with anomaly score
Trace-sample strip: inline sample traces for selected cell showing spans, classifier tag, and transport codes
Model-regression lane: timeline of model-version rollouts vs classifier 'model-error' rate
Per-customer SLO slider: interactively scope heatmap and contributor panel to specific tenants
implementation_notes: Taxonomy: final set = [timeout, overload, model-inference-error, model-timeout, transport-error-http, transport-error-grpc, client-misuse, infra-fault]. Use human-readable short codes for storage (e.g., TAX:MODEL_ERR)

Classifier architecture: rule-engine (first-pass) implemented as deterministic matches on span attributes -> NL features + numerical features into XGBoost model -> confidence score. Low-confidence falls back to 'ambiguous' tag
Enrichment: add 'kv_cache_miss_count', 'model_variant', 'inference_latency_ms', 'batch_size', 'node_cpu_pct' to span payload. Ensure PII is not attached.
Tracehook changes: add pre-emit hook to attach minimal context to root span; must be togglable via env var REDWOOD_TRACE_CLASSIFIER=enabled
Rollout: passive scoring for 2 weeks, then enable score-driven sampling (increase sample for 'model-inference-error' and 'timeout' by factor 5) in canary, then global
Ops: alerting rule templates for 'classifier_model_drift' and 'slo_breach_by_model' to be added to alertmanager
